title: scroll shouldnt change channel, agent, etc. in left or any panel, should use keys

items.content: Mouse scroll must not change selection in any panel; only keys do (FEN6)

summary: FEN6 is fixing this so that, in every panel, the mouse wheel only scrolls the view and never changes the selected channel, agent or anything else. Only keys and clicks will change the selection. Chat and terminal output will still scroll with the wheel as they do now. FEN6 will check the desktop window too, then open a PR without merging it.
